# Databases {#sec-databases}

::: {.callout-note title="From the exam description"}
Knowledge of bioinformatics' most important databases and understanding
their hierarchy and relationships.
:::

## Introduction

::: {.callout-warning title="To be written"}
Short introduction: primary (archival) vs. secondary (curated/derived)
databases; the INSDC collaboration; sequence → family → structure →
function → interaction databases; identifiers and cross-references.
:::

## Key concepts

- Primary nucleotide archives: INSDC (GenBank, ENA, DDBJ), SRA/ENA reads
- Genome databases and browsers: Ensembl, UCSC, NCBI RefSeq
- Protein sequence databases: UniProtKB (Swiss-Prot vs. TrEMBL), UniRef, UniParc, metagenomic sequence sets
- Protein families and domains: Pfam, InterPro (member databases), CDD
- Structure: PDB/wwPDB, EMDB; structure classifications SCOP, CATH, ECOD; predicted structures (AlphaFold DB)
- Function and pathways: Gene Ontology, KEGG, Reactome
- Interactions: STRING, IntAct, BioGRID
- Expression and proteomics repositories: GEO, ArrayExpress, PRIDE
- Curation vs. automatic annotation; error propagation; redundancy
- Retrieval systems: Entrez, EBI Search, programmatic access (APIs)

## Key papers

::: {.callout-tip}
★ = mandatory in earlier reading lists. The *Nucleic Acids Research* database
issue (every January) has an up-to-date paper for nearly every major
database — read the most recent one.
:::

### Sequences and genomes

- @uniprot2023 — UniProt.
- @cunningham2022 — Ensembl.

### Protein families and domains

- ★ @sonnhammer1997 — Pfam: domain families from seed alignments.
- @mistry2021 — Pfam, recent version.
- @paysanlafosse2023 — InterPro.

### Structures and structure classification

- @berman2000 — the Protein Data Bank.
- @murzin1995 — SCOP.
- @sillitoe2021 — CATH.
- ★ @cheng2014 — ECOD: an evolutionary classification of protein domains.
- @varadi2022 — AlphaFold Protein Structure Database.

### Function and interactions

- @ashburner2000 — the Gene Ontology.
- @go2023 — the Gene Ontology knowledgebase in 2023.
- @szklarczyk2023 — STRING.
